name: Call another rule
description: Runs a different rule and uses its result. Useful for breaking a big problem into reusable smaller rules — e.g. a façade rule that fans out to 1,500 small ones.

inputs.name: payload
inputs.description: Body to send to the sub-rule.

params.name: ruleId
params.description: ID of the rule to invoke.

params.name: version
params.description: Optional version pin. Latest published if omitted.
